meta_description:
2M likes, 5,255 comments - bhuvan.bam22 on August 4, 2026: "As a kid, I loved spraying the perfume testers my baba brought home from his work trips. I never imagined I’d one day create a perfume brand of my own.

Today, I launch SARKAR.

From spending countless hours perfecting the bottle design, to obsessing over every fragrance, to collecting feedback from over 150 people, my home slowly turned into a warehouse with more than 200 testers and sample bottles. 

The website is now live.

Choose your colour. Choose your fragrance.

And remember, YOU ARE ‘SARKAR’. 

@houseofsarkar".
